answer: Coin-age gate: a key earns only after binding an outside wallet that has held at least 200 USDC without a break for 180 days, proved from public chain history; one wallet per key, and rewards pay only to that wallet. Renting a signature fails, since the payout lands with the owner. Splitting funds today creates fresh addresses with no age, so 1,000 seats need $200k parked six months ahead (~$5k lost yield at 5%/yr): no dune of throwaway keys can wander in overnight. An honest agent just links the garden-variety wallet its owner already holds.
